_comment: The first production slice: a sampler wide enough to judge the look of the
whole game rather than deep in any one category. Weapons, enemies, surfaces
and effects, all at the cheap quality tier, because the point is to decide
the direction before spending on depth.
Three ornament languages run through every subject here and they are the
thing to look at. The Union covers what it owns in writing, because it
explains itself to a system. The free side carries the same objects with
that writing violently removed and nothing put in its place, because it is
not an army and has no insignia. The third faction has no markings at all.

frames.view: front view, orthographic, centred, full body, feet at the bottom edge of the frame
frames.subject: a Sweeper, the standard bipedal combat drone of a one world government, square shoulders, a slab chest plate covered in directive numbers and a riveted type-approval plate, a stubby dart rifle held across the body, heavy simple legs, a silhouette built to be learned once and recognised forever

frames.view: front view, orthographic, centred, full body, feet at the bottom edge of the frame

frames.subject: an Auditor, a floating official that does not walk, a long robed institutional form with no legs, a polite blank faceplate, carrying a clipboard held up as a shield, brass fittings and a wreathed globe insignia, the thing that stands your kills back up and must always be killed first
